body:
Hi Gary,

When someone in Amarillo searches for a garage door company today, they find A & H in the directories, and then it stops. There is no website where they can see what you do, check your hours, or read why your customers call you honest. Most people just move on to the next company that has one.

That is a waste of a story most companies would love to have. Locally owned since 1977, servicing all brands, with reviews that mention callbacks in minutes and no unnecessary repairs. None of that is working for you online right now.

So I designed a homepage for A & H, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. It leads with garage door repair and installation in Amarillo, lays out your services and hours, puts your phone number one tap away, and uses your real customer reviews.

Home service websites are my specialty. I built the site for Just Junk (justjunk.com), a removal company, around clear services and easy booking. I also built McCoy Roofing's website (mccoyroofing.com), a construction company that needed its services and work presented properly.

If you like the design, I can build it for real on your own domain. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas. Either way, no pressure.

Best,
Hassan
name: A & H Overhead Door
subject: 🚪 Family owned since 1977, and still no website
